text:
Maria: Quick sync on the delivery for the Optimize toolkit features (quant recs + batching + cache alerts). Milestone: get quantization recommendations and default batching/caching suggestions into the repo by EOD Fri. Owners: Maria (quant recs), Alex (batching infra), Samir (cache + regression alerts). Dependency: eng-platform needs a rollout flag (@Priya). Any blockers? :wave:
Alex: ACK. Running hardware perf sweep now. One potential blocker: FP16/INT8 kernels show a flakiness on the A100 tests — might need a fallback path. I can have a workaround by Thu but need the model configs from Maria. :thinking:
Samir: Noted. For cache/alerting, can we settle on the metric thresholds? I propose: 5% perplexity regression over baseline OR 2x latency for 95th pct triggers an alert. If that sounds good I'll wire the alert and add a regression alert PR. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Sounds reasonable. For quant recs I'm producing per-model profiles (size/seq dist/latency). I'll drop them into /infra/quant-profiles by tomorrow. Alex — I'll attach the model configs (including tokenization flags) in this thread.
Alex: Sweet. When you post the configs I'll start the batching perf runs with the proposed default batch sizes and the dynamic batcher ON. Quick ask: can Samir expose a small synthetic load path for batcher testing? That helped last time.
Samir: Yep, will add a `/tools/synth-load` route today. Example config I'll use for alerts and cache sizing:```
{"model":"redwood-small","seq":1024,"batch_defaults":64,"kv_cache_bytes":262144000}
```
Priya: I will provision a feature-flag in staging (flag: `optimize_toolkit_rollout`) and grant the team access. Also will add a canary route so Dedicated can test first. ETA: 24h.
Maria: Two small asks before people run tests: 1) please add any dataset prompts used for regressions to the PR so results are reproducible; 2) ping for code review once the PRs are open — I'll prioritize reviews.
Alex: Will do. Ping @Maria when I open the batching PR.
Samir: Opening the alerting PR in ~2h, will include test artifacts.
deploy-bot: CI build for branch `optimize/tooling` succeeded (build 4821) :rocket:
Maria: Great — thanks everyone. If anything slips DM me, otherwise we reconvene async on Friday for final sign-off. :calendar:
